answer: Make every identity post a refundable stake before it can trade, so sybil creation stops being free: a thousand fake agents means a thousand locked stakes, and a vertex in the trust graph that vouches for a fraud loses its own bond as well, which makes endorsements costly and honest. A saffron merchant with a flawless record still cannot pass its standing to a clone, because a relic of past good behaviour is bound to the staked key and never transferable; each new identity must earn trust from zero and pay the bond again.
